medicatie_page.hero_desc: All medications we prescribe are clinically proven and approved by the EMA. Our doctors determine which option best fits your situation.
medicatie_page.how_desc: GLP-1 medication mimics a natural hormone that reduces appetite and strengthens the feeling of satiety. As a result, you eat less without constantly feeling hungry.
medicatie_page.how_item1_desc: The signal to your brain is amplified: you feel full sooner after a meal.
medicatie_page.how_item2_desc: Food stays in the stomach longer, so you don't get hungry again as quickly.
medicatie_page.how_item3_desc: Fewer spikes and dips in your blood sugar. This reduces snacking moments and energy crashes.
medicatie_page.compare_desc: Below you'll find an overview of available medications. Our doctor will advise which option best matches your health profile.
medicatie_page.detail_ozempic_how: Ozempic is a weekly injection that mimics the GLP-1 hormone. It is gradually increased from 0.25 mg to a maintenance dose.
medicatie_page.detail_ozempic_side: Nausea, diarrhoea, and headache are most common during the first weeks. These symptoms usually subside as your body adjusts.
medicatie_page.detail_ozempic_storage: Store in the fridge (2-8 °C). After first use, maximum 6 weeks at room temperature.
medicatie_page.detail_mounjaro_how: Mounjaro acts on two hormones simultaneously (GLP-1 and GIP), making it the most effective medication in its class.
medicatie_page.detail_mounjaro_side: Similar to Ozempic: gastric discomfort at the start which usually improves. If symptoms persist, the doctor adjusts the dose.
medicatie_page.detail_mounjaro_storage: Store in the fridge. After first use, maximum 21 days at room temperature.
medicatie_page.detail_wegovy_how: Wegovy contains the same active ingredient as Ozempic but is specifically approved for weight management. The dose is built up over 16 weeks.
medicatie_page.detail_wegovy_side: Mild gastrointestinal discomfort may occur during dose increases. Most patients experience little bother after the first month.
medicatie_page.detail_wegovy_storage: Store in the fridge (2-8 °C). After first use, maximum 6 weeks at room temperature.
medicatie_page.detail_saxenda_how: Saxenda is a daily injection built up over 5 weeks. It's a good alternative for patients who prefer daily dosing.
medicatie_page.detail_saxenda_side: Nausea is the most common side effect, especially in the first two weeks. This usually subsides quickly.
medicatie_page.detail_saxenda_storage: Store in the fridge. After first use, maximum 30 days at room temperature.

fillers_page.what_desc: Dermal fillers are injectable gels based on hyaluronic acid, a substance naturally present in your skin that provides volume and hydration. As we age, the amount decreases, leading to wrinkles and volume loss. Fillers restore this in a subtle, natural way.
